title: Jina Reader (page rendering)
description: Jina Reader as gohort's page renderer: it opens a page in its own browser and gives back the readable text, so this machine needs no Chromium. Declared as a service you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at jina.ai/reader (it starts jina_; new keys come with free use). Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which reads example.com. Then put it to use by choosing it under Admin > Capabilities > Page Rendering (Browser): browse_page, and every fallback to a browser when a plain fetch fails, go through it. Only public web addresses are sent. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what pages cost. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.
